scripts.deploy: npm run build:github && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html && gh-pages -d dist -b gh-pages -r https://github.com/sarisarixchange/assetory.git
scripts.deploy-mcmaster: npm run build:mcmaster && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html && git add dist -f && git commit -m "Built files for McMaster $(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" --allow-empty && git push origin HEAD:mcmaster-deploy
